rows.evidence: Minimal no-X bridge_fit route and gllvmTMB R dispatch-to-direct-Julia roundtrip tested; X/missingness and TMB statistical parity still open.

Minimal no-X bridge_fit route and gllvmTMB no-X live dispatch tested. #91 high-rate divergence fixed on integration with fit-scale + analytic-vs-FD regression; full Pkg.test passed after follow-up changes.

Minimal no-X bridge_fit route tested. gllvmTMB transports binomial cbind(successes, failures) as Julia Y plus N for complete and missing-response no-X reduced-rank bridge rows, and the fixed-effect-X binomial formula path now matches direct gllvm_julia_fit() dispatch. Live bridge tests pass 416/416 against GLLVM.jl-integration. Broader R/TMB parity, mixed-family cbind, X+mask, and masked interval endpoints remain gates.

Minimal no-X bridge_fit route tested and R maps nbinom2 to negbinomial. Fixed-effect-X nbinom2 formula dispatch now matches direct gllvm_julia_fit() with finite positive dispersion. Conditional in-sample simulate() is routed via rnbinom(mu, size=r). Native TMB-vs-Julia parity, X+mask, non-Gaussian X CIs, and simulation calibration remain gates.

GLLVM.jl bridge surface reports NB1 one-part no-X support through bridge_capabilities(); gllvmTMB admits nbinom1()/nb1 complete balanced no-X reduced-rank fits through engine="julia", with formula-vs-direct logLik equality, a Wald phi CI smoke test, and post-fit predict/fitted/residuals/augment/simulate coverage. NB1 fixed-effect-X, missing-response-mask, masked simulation, profile/bootstrap, native-TMB parity, and mixed-family cells remain queued and fail deliberately.
Minimal no-X bridge_fit route tested; precision transform and live R parity remain gates. Conditional in-sample simulate() is routed via rbeta(mu*phi, (1-mu)*phi) for current bridge objects.

Minimal no-X bridge_fit route tested; #96 mode-finder safeguards fixed locally; Gamma now defaults analytic after quick/medium finite-vs-analytic benchmarks with |delta logLik| <= 1.9e-12 and full Pkg.test green. Fixed-effect-X Gamma formula dispatch now matches direct gllvm_julia_fit(); conditional in-sample simulate() is routed via rgamma(shape=alpha, scale=mu/alpha). Gamma X CIs and native TMB parity remain queued.
Minimal no-X bridge_fit route tested; cutpoint, prediction, and R label route remain gates.
Keep as experimental until parity/recovery gates are recorded.

Minimal bridge test checks rotated loading parity to direct Julia fits; R Procrustes parity still needed.

R bridge admits complete balanced one-part X rows for Gaussian, Poisson, Binomial, NB2, Beta, and Gamma against GLLVM.jl-integration. Public formula-vs-direct dispatch evidence is live for all admitted X families; latest mixed-family bridge suite passes 496/496. X+mask, ordinal X, NB1 X, mixed-family X, non-Gaussian X CIs, newdata, and native TMB-vs-Julia parity remain unsupported gates.

No-X response masks are engine+bridge verified for Poisson, Bernoulli Binomial, cbind Binomial, NB2, Beta, Gamma, and Ordinal-probit against GLLVM.jl-integration. Gaussian masks, X+mask, mixed missingness, and masked CI endpoints remain unsupported gates.
Explicit mi() design only; no imputation shortcut.
Define or deliberately reject.

GLLVM.jl bridge surface reports a mixed-family vector route for no-X/no-mask fits; gllvmTMB d22d0de admits the narrow complete balanced trait-aligned no-X/no-mask/no-CI mixed-family Julia route after selector metadata, per-trait labels, direct-wrapper logLik equality, row-family-aware post-fit methods, and method-specific unavailable-CI statuses were validated. NB1 is not admitted inside mixed-family vectors yet; it remains a separate partial no-X one-part R bridge row.

Gaussian profile CIs now route through confint.gllvmTMB_julia and live julia-bridge tests pass against GLLVM.jl-integration; wider family/status coverage and profile visuals remain gates.

R-first post-fit bridge surface now includes coef(), tidy(), glance(), augment(), summary(), print(summary()), predict(), fitted(), residuals(), simulate(), nobs(), ordination extractors, ordiplot(), and plot(type="ordination") for current in-sample bridge payloads. Conditional in-sample simulate() is routed for gaussian, poisson, binomial, NB2, NB1, Beta, Gamma, and narrow trait-aligned mixed-family objects; live bridge tests pass 496/496 against GLLVM.jl-integration. Still unsupported: newdata prediction/augmentation, link-scale augment rows, fixed-effects-only augment rows, covariance/CI/diagnostic payloads in glance, unconditional/bootstrap-grade simulation, masked-response simulation, ordinal simulation/probability payloads, tidy SE/CI columns, tidy random parameters/cutpoints, vcov payloads, broader plots, and richer diagnostic residuals.
